name: @commerceworker/sdk-rich-text
description: Render CommerceWorker rich text (RichTextDocument) to HTML, Markdown or plain text. Zero dependencies; any framework, any runtime.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --rootDir src
